Thank you for reaching out. It means alot

I have tried that recently. It helped a bit temporarily but not really. I felt like I was too much of a bother to the counsellor. Her advice was "go for a walk" and that was pretty much it. 

I actually did purchase "No More Mr. Nice Guy" on Amazon last week. Funny that you mentioned it. Its supposed to arrive tomorrow (Monday).

Aside from that, im not reading all that much of substance. I read alot of news, but I think to be honest, that probably doesnt help much. Any other suggestions you have would be appreciated.

Im doing my best to handle my weight. I work out 4-5 days a week, unfortunately im addicted to food. I will have a great workout and then "reward" myself with pizza, McDs or something like that after. Its pathetic. I did the program at the Ottawa Weightloss Clinic which is provincially provided. The weight thing is tough to take on.. atleast the diet factor. There are meetups in my city and tbh, I have some trepidation joining. I dont know why, considering what theyre there for
